content:
I'm thrilled to share that I’ve officially joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! 🎉

Since first diving into the CDS Hooks standard back in 2017, I’ve been passionate about its potential to transform clinical decision support and enable smarter, more timely insights at the point of care. Over the years, I’ve had the privilege of working with teams across healthcare and health tech to implement and advocate for interoperable, standards-based solutions—and now, I’m honored to help shape the future of CDS Hooks from within the PMC.

I’m excited to continue collaborating with the community to move the standard forward, making it even more robust, accessible, and impactful for providers, developers, and patients alike.

🌟 If you're already using CDS Hooks in production — fantastic! Please help grow our visibility and momentum by adding your implementation to the public list:  
https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

🚀 And if you’re exploring CDS Hooks but haven’t started implementation yet — I’m available as a freelance consultant to help you navigate integration, design high-value hooks, and bring your CDS use cases to life.

Let’s keep advancing smarter, interoperable healthcare together. #CDSHooks #Interoperability #HealthcareInnovation #FHIR #DigitalHealth #CDS #HL7
